items.issue: The narration treats NLP as a scientifically grounded PTSD treatment that overwrites memories and can be reverse-engineered to implant attraction.
items.disposition: Verify against authoritative clinical reviews and primary NLP/therapy sources; otherwise preserve only as Mikey's unsupported account and never as treatment or manipulation advice.

items.issue: Opening Chinese claims, English street/interview lines and the alleged Jeffries birthday quotation are not tied to complete original clips.
items.disposition: Continuously review 0-100 and 420-449 seconds, identify the original sources and verify exact wording before quotation or named attribution.

items.issue: Dates, platform bans, audience growth, method authorship, forum adoption and industry scale are precise external facts without citations.
items.disposition: Require contemporaneous platform notices, publications, forum archives and financial records; do not integrate as established history before verification.

items.issue: The video describes anchoring, embedded commands, emotional triggering and 'hijacking' in a way that could be operationalized as covert control.
items.disposition: Keep permissions closed and retain only a non-actionable critique; explicit, informed and ongoing consent cannot be replaced by inferred emotional response.

items.issue: ASR corrupts key terms and names, including 'PUA/PVA', 'anchor', 'embedded commands', 'dopamine', 'hack', 'ordinary people' and several English excerpts.
items.disposition: Listen to original audio and check on-screen text before exact quotation or technical terminology.

items.issue: Archival, stock, film, public and report imagery may be illustrative and is not provenance-linked in the package.
items.disposition: Review dense windows at 0-100, 135-175, 258-351, 420-449 and 489-525 seconds and record original clip provenance before using images as evidence.
